---
title: "E303: Undeclared state"
description: "With a `states` field, every state used must be declared (this catches typos)."
---

<!-- Generated by `delta gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

With a `states` field, every state used must be declared (this catches typos).

## Example

```delta error
dfa M (partial) {
  states q0
  start q0
  accept q0
  q0 -a-> q1
}
```
